selection.entropy_definition: mean per-view entropy divided by log(10)
selection.percentile_definition: within-true-class average tie rank divided by class_size-1; no min-max stretching
selection.sampling: identity-keyed shared Gumbel top-k without replacement
selection.deterministic_tail: highest calibration entropy Top10 per true class

teacher.training: CV-DD squeeze_imagenette-derived ImageWoof teacher; final epoch300 checkpoint

student.normalization_layer: GroupNorm(C,C), called instance in released code

augmentation.train: exact ImageNette deterministic released 256 pipeline and identity-keyed randomness
augmentation.test: ResizeShorter256 bilinear antialias, CenterCrop256, ImageNet normalization
